_about: Single source for corner radius and motion, shared by the Swift app (Inlet/InletTheme.swift) and the website (website/css/tokens.css). Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/build-tokens.py. CI runs it with --check.

radius._about: Points in the app, CSS px on the site. Radii nest: inner = outer - inset (Apple ConcentricRectangle rule). Use the scale names; never a raw number.

nesting.use: selected row inside a results panel
group or row inside a panel with 16 pt padding
card inside a panel with 12 pt padding
keycap or symbol tile inside a small tile

motion._about: Durations in seconds. Springs use Spring(duration:bounce:) and match SwiftUI's model: bounce 0 is critically damped, bounce b gives damping ratio 1 - b. The website gets the same curve as a CSS linear() easing.

press.use: icon and button press, release overshoot

open.use: full grid appears, icons ripple out

morph.use: search capsule melts into the results panel

rise.use: quick panel rises out of the Dock icon

settle.use: grid reflow when a search filters icons

dismiss.use: anything closing; never bounce on the way out
